brief:
The U.S. government is taking legal action against a campus labor union at the University of Michigan over its advocacy for Palestine, according to Mondoweiss. The action reflects efforts to prosecute the union's political organizing and statements on the issue.

The reported move has drawn concern from labor organizers who view it as government suppression of union speech and activism. Mondoweiss framed the case as part of a broader pattern of legal pressure against pro-Palestine organizing efforts, particularly on American university campuses where student and worker activism around the issue has grown in recent years.
dek: The U.S. government is criminalizing a campus labor union at the University of Michigan for supporting Palestine. We are calling on fellow labor organizers to resist this dangerous act of repression…
title: U.S. government pursues case against Michigan labor union for Palestine support
